transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Carter, the S-3, and I'll be publishing the final staffing roster for the coordination cell once we've completed our qualification scrub. As a reminder, the cell will run from 0600 to 1800 each day of the four-day exercise, and we have three desks to fill: partner liaison, POL accountability, and movement control. Each desk requires a currently qualified person. Our available personnel are Sgt Malik, Cpl Ortiz, and Spc Vega. Before I publish the roster, I need to run the routine pre-exercise qualification scrub with personnel, logistics, and signal staff. Let's get started -- who has the qualification records for these three soldiers?
